title: Gathering & Crafting — 1.0 original art production readiness
requirements: Every unique item has its own separately generated original D&D 5e-inspired painted picture, matching its exact name and description
No crop from a composite or sprite sheet
No reused art under different item IDs
If a material is also a recipe result, reuse exactly the same artwork path for the same item
Do not release 1.0.0 until all items pass manual visual review and automated packaging checks
